status: PREPARED - NOT RUN (v1.1: exclusion + supplementary arm + auto zero-shot)
question: Does retrieving verified NL->MQL examples (provisional_corpus_v1) improve Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct cross-engine execution accuracy on the 892 MQL-0006 items, versus zero-shot and versus random examples?

model.label: qwen2.5-coder-3b-instruct
model.dtype_note: MQL-0006 ran bfloat16 on a Tesla T4 (emulated bf16). Required, never substituted: the notebook fails if unsupported.
model.oom_policy: a batch that hits CUDA OOM is retried one prompt at a time (same prompt/dtype/decoding) and the record says so

prompt.rag_rule: RAG prompt = zero-shot prompt with one reference block inserted before the final 'Question:' line; empty context => byte-identical to zero-shot

evaluation.source: MQL-0006 bundle nl2mql_spider_dev_1034_bundle_v2 (gold SQL, gold rows and SQLite files are NOT shipped)

retrieval.index: per target database, target-db documents excluded
retrieval.dedup: same doc_id, same MQL, or same normalised question: higher-ranked copy kept

context.token_budgeting: Qwen2.5 tokenizer at the pinned revision (HF AutoTokenizer, add_special_tokens=False) over system+user text and the block; over-budget documents are skipped (dropped_budget), never truncated

B_random_k3.label: B. random 3 training examples (frozen seed, as MQL-0005 random_k3)

C_hybrid_k3.label: C. relevant hybrid RAG, k=3, no guide cards

D_supp_allow_near_dup.label: D. SUPPLEMENTARY sensitivity: arm C without the near-duplicate exclusion, only on the items the exclusion changes

leakage_gates.exact: normalised (lowercase alphanumeric tokens) eval question == corpus question or question_raw
leakage_gates.on_any_hit: STOP; do not filter (would break exactly-3,589 and corpus-v1 immutability); ask the user

acknowledged_near_duplicates.decision: user 2026-11-06: keep corpus unmodified (3,589). v1.1 (2026-11-06, user): deterministic evaluation-specific retrieval exclusion in arms B and C + supplementary sensitivity arm D
acknowledged_near_duplicates.reason: same question template differing in one entity word ('editors'/'teachers'/'conductors'); different databases and schemas; no shared answer

stated_deviations_from_MQL-0005: corpus pattern labels come from train SQL via scripts/rag/patterns.sql_patterns (same function), but the corpus is provisional_corpus_v1 (sql2mql-v2, Verifier-3), not the 280 Spider-dev saved predictions
masked_question for corpus databases uses schema words from official Spider tables.json (validated equal to the Atlas-manifest words on the 17 evaluation databases)
the 'text_number' pattern flag for a corpus database is derived from the columns its corpus rows touched (observed text + numeric declared type), not from the whole-database Atlas manifest
token budgeting uses the Hugging Face tokenizer (MQL-0005 used the llama.cpp GGUF tokenizer); MQL-0005 ran GGUF q4_k_m, this runs HF bf16
arm A may reuse MQL-0006 predictions (same model revision, prompt, decoding, dtype, batch size); library versions may differ
retrieval_exclusions_note: Evaluation-specific, deterministic, applied to arms B and C after ranking (index/IDF/dedup untouched). Corpus file unchanged. Supplementary arm D re-runs only the items whose selection the exclusion changes, with the exclusion off (sensitivity analysis).
zero_shot_mode_rule: auto: reuse MQL-0006 only if torch, transformers, accelerate, tokenizers and the GPU name equal the MQL-0006 run's, plus the static checks; otherwise generate a fresh arm A in the same environment as B and C
